PR07: address third-review chrome, ruler, and doc issues

- Split the committed SVG into frame-base/elements layers only when an
  element underlay is interposed; unthemed rendering keeps the original
  single document, and shared resource definitions are duplicated into
  every layer so url(#...) fills resolve in each rendered document.
- Ruler tick lengths are unspecified by default and derive from the
  effective thickness exactly like the legacy unthemed ruler, so opting
  into the standard aggregate theme no longer shortens every tick.
- Remove remaining grid-restyle claims from the runbook and the
  pr-07 chrome-theming plan; the snippet API guard is replaced by a
  public-barrel compile fixture (landing with pr-09).
